limitations: 6 units were excluded because their route is incomplete (production events rejected during import).
Rankings are statistical associations in observational data, not confirmed root causes.
The change point is estimated from 268 units up to the trigger; 28 units are in the shifted regime. Small post-change samples widen uncertainty.
Factors are strongly associated with each other and cannot be separated: batch~shift (V=0.85).
13 candidate levels were not estimable (e.g. material batches that exist only after the change).
Equipment events near the change point are shown as context and do not affect the ranking, because routine events exist for every resource.
Only recorded factors can be ranked; an unrecorded cause will not appear in this list.
